scanNote: Modul muqovasining o'ng beti — kitobda raqamlanmagan.

exercises.explanationUz:
BESH KO'NIKMA — modul oxirida shularni qila olishingiz kerak:

  tell the time        — vaqtni aytish
  ask about pets       — uy hayvonlari haqida so'rash
  buy clothes          — kiyim sotib olish
  order food           — ovqat buyurtma qilish
  accept/refuse offers — taklifni qabul qilish / rad etish

Bular AMALIY ko'nikmalar — chet elda yoki ingliz tilida
muloqot qilganda darhol kerak bo'ladi.

items.whyUz: 'tell THE time' — 'the' shart. 'say the time' EMAS.
'ask ABOUT' — biror mavzu haqida so'ramoq. 'a pet' — uy hayvoni.

exercises.instructionUz: Bu modulda quyidagi grammatikani mashq qilasiz:
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'QQIZ GRAMMATIK MAVZU:

  adverbs of frequency      — takrorlanish ravishlari
                              (always, usually, often, sometimes, never)
  prepositions of time      — vaqt predloglari (at, on, in)
  question words            — so'roq so'zlari
                              (what, where, when, who, why, how)
  present continuous        — hozirgi davomli zamon
                              (I am reading)
  plurals                   — ko'plik (Unit 3 dan davomi)
  countable/uncountable nouns — sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar
  how much / how many       — qancha? nechta?
  (a) few / (a) little      — ozgina / kam
  a / an / some / any       — artikl va aniqlovchilar

Bularning ba'zilari 1-modulda boshlangan (plurals, a/an/some/any)
va bu yerda CHUQURLASHTIRILADI.

items.whyUz: always, usually, often, sometimes, never. Fe'ldan OLDIN turadi.
what, where, when, who, why, how, which, whose.
am/is/are + fe'l-ing. HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish.
Bir, ikki, uch deb sanaladigan: a book, two books.
Sanalmaydi: water, milk, rice. Ko'plik shakli yo'q.
How much water? How much money?
How many books? How many people?

exercises.explanationUz:
2-MODULNING TO'RTTA UNITI:

  UNIT 5 — An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
           kundalik tartib, bo'sh vaqt

  UNIT 6 — Birds of a Feather!
           hayvonlar

  UNIT 7 — Come Rain or Shine
           ob-havo, kiyim

  UNIT 8 — Enjoy your Meal!
           ovqat va ichimlik turlari, oshxona jihozlari

Har bir unit nomi — INGLIZCHA IBORA yoki MAQOL.
Ularni bilish ingliz tilini yaxshi tushunishga yordam beradi.

sentences.uz: Yomg'ir yog'sa ham, quyosh chiqsa ham
sentences.noteUz:
IBORA: 'come rain or shine' = nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, har qanday holatda.
Masalan: 'I go running every morning, come rain or shine.'
7-unit mavzusi ob-havo bo'lgani uchun bu nom tanlangan.
sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy, snowy, hot, cold...

DOIM ko'plikda. 'a clothes' yoki 'a clothe' YO'Q.
Bitta kiyim uchun: 'an item of clothing' yoki aniq nomi (a shirt).

Ovqat oldidan aytiladigan ibora.
Boshqa variantlar: 'Bon appétit!' (fransuzcha, ingliz tilida ham ishlatiladi),
'Enjoy!' (qisqacha, AQShda).

'equipment' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot. 'equipments' YO'Q.
Bitta buyum uchun: 'a piece of equipment'.

wordFormation.introUz: 2-modul muqovasi — grammatik atamalar va doim ko'plik otlar.

groups.explanationUz: Bu so'zlarni bilish darslikni mustaqil o'qishga yordam beradi.
Bu otlar birlik shaklga ega emas — fe'l ham ko'plikda bo'ladi.
Bu otlarga -s qo'shilmaydi va fe'l BIRLIKDA bo'ladi.
Taklifga javob berish uchun ikki qarama-qarshi fe'l.

patterns.formula: What time is it? — It's + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: What time is it? — It's half past three.
I always get up at seven. She never watches TV.
patterns.exampleUz: Men doim yettida turaman. U hech qachon televizor ko'rmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: always, usually, often, sometimes, never — fe'ldan OLDIN turadi.

patterns.formula: AT + soat, ON + kun, IN + oy/yil.
patterns.exampleEn: at seven o'clock, on Monday, in July
I am reading a book now.
patterns.explanationUz: HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish. Present Simple dan farqi shu.

patterns.formula: How much + sanalmaydigan? / How many + sanaladigan?
patterns.exampleEn: How much water? How many books?
